title: fix: handle missing 'main' key in API response
author: dev-rohan
description:
Fixes #2.

Added a check for the 'main' key before accessing it. Returns a clean error dict instead of raising KeyError.

The API format change was documented in their changelog. This handles it gracefully.
diff_summary: src/weather.py: added `if 'main' not in data: return {'error': 'Unexpected API response format.'}`
